findings.issue: Archive recovery could turn an accepted root into a child.
findings.disposition: Fixed by comparing accepted source ancestry, including an observed root. The root and child controls pass.

findings.issue: Superseded archive reads could supply event coverage or dependent family links to publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed by accepting annotation inputs under one registry view and discarding or regrouping superseded inputs during final projection. Deterministic tests cover both interleavings.

findings.issue: A healthy-path budget retry spent source bytes before checking its metadata reservation.
findings.disposition: Fixed by retaining healthy-path preflight order. The existing native one-byte regression passes.

findings.issue: The archive lookup was reported to introduce a separate uncharged session allowance.
findings.disposition: Refuted. Baseline exact lookup and archive repair use the same configured discovery-path ceiling, separate from scheduled owner attempts, with shared byte accounting. Production CLI limits populate both ceilings.
